pilot_name: Move the Damn Data — First Live Pilot

workflow.description: Receive an authorized intake event, validate required fields, create or update one permitted record, prepare a follow-up draft, and require human approval before any external message is sent.

go_live_requirements: user selects first real use case
user identifies or connects the two systems involved
connector permissions are reviewed and least-privilege scoped
test tenant or isolated pilot account is available where practical
end-to-end dry run passes with synthetic or non-sensitive test data
explicit human approval is given for the specific live pilot
